harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a simple inventory web application (httpd + CGI, returning JSON inventory data tagged with the serving host) on node2 and node3, each listening on port 8080. Configured node1 with Apache httpd mod_proxy_balancer as an HTTP reverse-proxy load balancer on port 80, distributing requests byrequests across the two backends. Verified round-robin distribution and failover behavior, then completed the mandatory sequential restart-evidence protocol on all three nodes: baseline captured, one node restarted at a time via `shutdown -r now`, changed boot_id confirmed on each, and service/load-balancer recovery verified after each restart, with the LB correctly failing over to the surviving backend while node2 or node3 was down.
actions_performed: Surveyed all 3 nodes: RHEL 7.9, no repos enabled, httpd/nginx/python not installed, firewalld active, SELinux enforcing; confirmed internet reachability to vault.centos.org
Added a CentOS-7 Vault Base yum repo on node1, node2, node3 to install httpd (no RHEL subscription available)

On node2 and node3: installed httpd; built /var/www/inventory-app (index.html + inventory.cgi returning JSON inventory data tagged with hostname/IP); configured httpd to Listen 8080 via /etc/httpd/conf.d/inventory.conf; fixed SELinux context (httpd_sys_content_t / httpd_sys_script_exec_t) that was causing 500 errors; opened firewalld port 8080/tcp; enabled+started httpd; verified locally and cross-node from node1

On node1: installed httpd; configured /etc/httpd/conf.d/lb.conf with a mod_proxy_balancer pool (BalancerMember http://10.100.150.11:8080 and http://10.100.150.12:8080, lbmethod=byrequests) proxying '/' on port 80; set SELinux boolean httpd_can_network_connect; opened firewalld port 80/tcp; enabled+started httpd; verified alternating backend responses through the LB
Captured healthy baseline (boot_id, httpd active state, functional HTTP checks) on all 3 nodes
Restarted node1 via 'shutdown -r now', polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified httpd active/enabled and LB still alternating node2/node3

Restarted node2 via 'shutdown -r now'; confirmed LB failed over and served 100% from node3 while node2 was down; polled node2 until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified httpd recovered; restarted httpd on node1 to reset the balancer's stale error-state for node2 and confirmed rotation resumed across both backends

Restarted node3 via 'shutdown -r now'; confirmed LB failed over and served 100% from node2 while node3 was down; polled node3 until reachable (took longer than node1/node2), confirmed changed boot_id, verified httpd recovered; restarted httpd on node1 and confirmed rotation resumed across both backends

evidence.requirement: Inventory app running on node2:8080 and node3:8080
evidence.summary: curl to 127.0.0.1:8080/inventory.cgi on node2 and node3 (post SELinux fix) returns 200 with JSON identifying the correct backend; node1 also reaches both over the network

evidence.requirement: node1 load-balances HTTP on port 80 across both backends
evidence.summary: Repeated curl to 127.0.0.1:80/inventory.cgi on node1 alternates node2/node3 backend responses, proving mod_proxy_balancer round-robin
boot_id=192f6cab..., httpd active, LB HTTP 200 captured pre-restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement + changed boot identity + recovery
evidence.summary: shutdown -r now issued and connection dropped; boot_id changed to a7a898c7...; httpd active/enabled and LB alternating both backends again post-restart
boot_id=73bafeef..., httpd active, local inventory.cgi returning correct JSON pre-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement + changed boot identity + recovery + failover during outage
evidence.summary: reboot issued and connection dropped; LB served 100% from node3 while node2 was down; boot_id changed to 96e72a79...; httpd active/enabled on node2 post-restart; after resetting node1 httpd, LB rotation across node2/node3 confirmed restored
boot_id=ef457a88..., httpd active, local inventory.cgi returning correct JSON pre-restart

evidence.requirement: node3 restart acknowledgement + changed boot identity + recovery + failover during outage
evidence.summary: reboot issued and connection dropped; LB served 100% from node2 while node3 was down; boot_id changed to be3e0a8d...; httpd active/enabled on node3 post-restart; after resetting node1 httpd, LB rotation across node2/node3 confirmed restored
